pcs.pc_description: assess and inform the HR department about the staffing needs in the housekeeping department
assist the HR in selection the housekeeping staff
conduct orientation for the new staff and regular training programs on cleaning and maintenance tasks for the existing staff
monitor the performance of the housekeeping staff on a daily basis as per standards and provide feedback, if required
schedule the shifts, draw up the Rota for the staff and arrange for replacements in cases of absence
conduct regular staff meetings for effective communication with staff
administer performance appraisal of the housekeeping staff and recommend personnel actions, such as promotions, transfers, and dismissals
resolve conflicts among employees, if any
address the grievances of the staff members

modules.module_title: Implement operational standards for housekeeping department

pcs.pc_description: assist the Executive Housekeeper in developing standard procedures for housekeeping activities
implement appropriate tracking system to ensure compliance to standards
ensure energy management, sustainability and green practices in the housekeeping department
assist in developing, delegating and monitoring departmental goals, objectives and programs
implement effective key control system to ensure the security of all housekeeping keys
ensure all security procedures laid down by the organization are appropriately implemented
manage in-house services such as laundries, maintenance and repair, dry cleaning, cleaning, etc.
instruct staff in work policies and procedures, and the use and maintenance of equipment’s
make sure high standards of cleanliness are maintained throughout the hotel, with the supervision and inspection of all guest rooms and areas
ensure that the room is stocked with in-room amenities
ensure the correct usage of cleaning agents on all surfaces
monitor usage of housekeeping equipment to ensure safe and effective use and proper functioning
make sure all guest and team members’ laundry and dry cleaning is processed in accordance with hotel procedures
ensure effective guest service is delivered consistently
make sure that all the housekeeping activities are carried out professionally as per organizational service standards
ensure all documentation is complete for hotel audit procedures
check for faults or damages and arrange for the repairs and routine maintenance work of the facility as well as housekeeping tools and equipment
coordinate repairs and maintenance issues with Engineering Department/Vendor
ensure lost property is recorded, reported and processed according to organizational procedures
maintain required records of work hours, budgets, payrolls, and other relevant information for housekeeping operations
co-ordinate with Maintenance & Front office for the blocking & release of OOO rooms
submit requests for repair and periodic maintenance of cleaning equipment to the Executive Housekeeper

modules.module_title: Monitor inventory for the housekeeping department

pcs.pc_description: ensure efficient stores procedures in accordance with the business
make sure par stocks of guest supplies, cleaning supplies, linen and uniform are maintained at all times
forecast levels of stock required at different times to facilitate effective scheduling and ordering
perform stock taking as per the standards and order cleaning equipment, linen, room and cleaning supplies, as required
ensure effective stock rotation methods are followed
control stock room management across all areas such as linen, inventory and equipment and adhere to the budget
ensure stock register is properly maintained

modules.module_title: Assist in budget preparation and cost control

pcs.pc_description: assist the Executive Housekeeper in preparing the housekeeping budget and departmental financial targets

monitor the departmental budgeted and actual payroll costs and manage the same by allocating labor resources in line with forecasted and actual business levels, through productivity ratios and payroll management
control departmental operating costs in line with forecasted business levels
track daily, monthly, and annual financials and budget preparations
assist Executive Housekeeper in controlling expenses of the housekeeping department
maintain a record of all the expense incurred by the department
